# Code Anchors: Add Items Drawer

- `src/pages/AddItemsDrawer.tsx` — the bottom drawer: header with Close and Add, text box, keyboard-sized layout, the pending IDs, and the one write of new and re-listed lines
- `src/app/addDraft.tsx` — holds the typed text, the picked links and the reserved IDs above the List page
- `src/app/keyboard.ts` — the part of the screen the on-screen keyboard leaves visible
- `src/data/itemLines.ts` — reads the text line by line, the quantity suffix, and the 50-line and 100-character limits
- `src/data/itemLines.test.ts` — tests line reading and the limits
- `src/pages/ListPage.tsx` — the Add item button that opens the drawer
- `src/pages/ListPage.test.tsx` — tests the drawer's adds, re-listed items, failed saves, retries and kept text
- `src/services/firestoreData.ts` — the one all-or-nothing write that creates new items and re-lists existing ones
- `src/app/saveWait.ts` — the 8-second wait for the server and the record ID each line gets
- `firestore.rules` — the item create and update rules each drawer write must pass
